test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II (AAO) 2023 Official Paper-III (Held On: 27 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Income Statement of a charitable institution is known as:
solution:
The correct answer is**Income and Expenditure A/c.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Income and Expenditure A/c:**

 
 
• It is a summary of all income earned and expenses incurred by a charitable institution during a specific period, usually a financial year.
 
• This account reflects the operating results of the institution, showing whether it has a surplus or deficit.
 
• It is similar to the Profit and Loss A/c used by for-profit businesses but adapted for non-profit organizations.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Receipts and Payments A/c:**

 
 
• This is a cash-based summary of all receipts and payments made during a financial period. It does not consider accruals and thus does not show the financial performance accurately.
 
 
 
• **Profit and Loss A/c:**
 
 
• This account is used by for-profit businesses to show the profitability over a period. Charitable institutions use the Income and Expenditure A/c instead.
 
 
 
• **Statement of Affairs:**
 
 
• This is a statement showing the financial position of an organization, including its assets and liabilities. It is not used to reflect the income and expenditure of a period.
